Chapter 697 - 697 Ten Months Pregnancy; River Of Time

Chapter 697 - 697 Ten Months Pregnancy; River of Time

697 Ten Months Pregnancy; River of Time

Everyone hugged each other.

After a long time, they slowly separated.

Lin Fan said, “If nothing special happens, I won’t leave.”

This was the decision he had made before he returned.

Lin Fan had left Earth previously because he wanted to obtain more power to protect Earth.

Now, although he was not the strongest, he was still very strong.

He also possessed the ability to continuously become stronger even on Earth… That was the advanced system!

Other than that, Lin Fan also had a formation that could protect Earth from being harmed.

Now, he was confident that he could protect Earth and his family!

…

When everyone heard this, their beautiful eyes lit up.

Ten years had long made them suffer from lovesickness.

Now, there was finally no need for that.

Lin Fan ate a sumptuous meal with them. It was warm and cozy.

Then, Lin Fan took out many spirit crystals and arranged them in a special way.

Then, he used a special method to write countless mysterious runes in the spirit crystals and the void.

These talismans spread and rippled in circles.

Gradually, they enveloped the entire Earth.

The entire Earth turned dark.

After a while, it returned to normal.

At the same time, a sense of security and heaviness that they had never felt before rose in the hearts of everyone on Earth.

“The protective array formation has been successfully set up!”

Lin Fan heaved a sigh of relief.

This defensive array was an Emperor-grade defensive array obtained from the advanced system. It had the powerful function of concealing aura, reducing size, and even blocking the attacks of Emperor-grade experts.

In the universe, the Earth had already become the size of a rock. People who traveled across the universe could not discover it at all.

Right now, Lin Fan knew that the emperor level was a level higher than the Planet level.

With this formation, at least for a short period of time, the safety of Earth was guaranteed.

This was also the main reason why Lin Fan returned to Earth.

Then, Lin Fan set up a small defensive formation around the Coiling Dragon Villa. He planted the Path-Understanding Tree, Immortal Rice Seeds, Heaven Climbing Pine, and other plants in the villa.

In an instant, the entire villa was filled with a sea of spiritual energy. With a breath, he felt as if he had become a few years younger. He felt comfortable and relaxed to the extreme.

Following that, Lin Fan called Lin Tao, Lin Xiaoyao, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Qiu Ziqian and the rest to the Path-Understanding Tree. He brought them to comprehend the five elements, space, time and other laws. He also taught them various cultivation techniques.

Although Earth… especially the Coiling Dragon Villa, had enough spiritual energy to prolong one’s life…

The lifespan of humans was still very limited.

Cultivation, on the other hand, could continuously increase one’s lifespan.

Everyone understood this principle, so they cultivated very seriously.

…

Time flowed like water. In the blink of an eye, another ten years had passed.

In the past ten years, Lin Fan had been receiving rewards from the system every year.

All kinds of rewards, coupled with his continuous cultivation, allowed his cultivation to increase greatly in the past ten years.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Level-Nine Planet (3.5 billion/10 billion)

[Skills: Sword 81 (Ordinary), Curse Spell (Emperor), Sword Nurturing Technique (Emperor), Cosmos Sword Technique (Emperor)…]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Ordinary), Flame Armor (Emperor), Heavenly Soul Pearl (Emperor), True Dragon Sword (Emperor)…]

[Laws: Time (elementary), Space (intermediate), Metal (intermediate), Wood (intermediate), Water (intermediate), Fire (intermediate), Earth (intermediate), Life (elementary), Death (elementary)]

[Character Relationship:]

[Lin Tao: Daddy; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Dai Weixue: Mom; Favorability:Ten stars]

[Lin Xiaoyao: Sister; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Xue: Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Bing, Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

Seeing this, Lin Fan muttered, “In these ten years, I will grasp the laws of life and death. Then, I will grasp two more laws and raise them to the intermediate level. After that, I’ll be able to raise the time law.”

Time was the most important thing in the world, and Lin Fan had an inexplicable obsession with it.

“Next, what laws should I comprehend?”

The sky that was originally filled with the scorching sun suddenly darkened.

A gust of cold wind whistled from afar.

Lin Tao walked out and said, “It was still sunny just now, but now it’s overcast… It’s going to rain.”

Lin Fan’s eyes twitched as he muttered, “Yin? Yang?”

But soon, he frowned again.

Yin and yang were undoubtedly two extremely powerful laws.

However, how should he cultivate them?

For a moment, he was a little confused.

A thunderclap sounded. The lightning bolt twisted crazily, as if it had torn countless cracks in the sky.

Heavy rain fell.

With Lin Fan’s abilities and skills in formations, he could totally block the rain and the wind from the Coiling Dragon Villa.

However, he did not do that.

Sometimes, experiencing the changes of the four seasons and nature was also beneficial.

Lin Fan returned to his room and was still thinking about the yin and yang laws.

At this moment, the door was slowly pushed open.

Hu Tian walked in.

At this moment, Hu Tian was wearing a red cheongsam.

Time had not left a single mark on Hu Tian’s fair and beautiful face. She had a curvaceous figure and a slender, smooth waist without an inch of fat. Under her perky buttocks was a pair of long, beautiful legs.
